items.title: Multi-statement transactions for Apache Iceberg tables in Amazon Redshift
items.summary: Amazon Redshift now supports multi-statement transactions for Apache Iceberg tables, so you can run several DML statements against one Iceberg table inside a single BEGIN…COMMIT and publish them as one atomic Iceberg snapshot. This post explains why one commit per statement makes multi-step pipelines fragile, what you can run in a transaction, and how it performs.
items.creator: Shiyu Xu

items.title: Build a self-healing ETL pipeline with Amazon Bedrock AgentCore
items.summary: Build a self-healing ETL pipeline on AWS Glue and Amazon Bedrock AgentCore that automatically corrects bad records using domain knowledge, writes the fixes back to the data lake, and can open pull requests to prevent the same errors from recurring.
items.creator: Kevin Tinn
